{{Quote|A topic will flash on your screen. Whoever hits their response button first will tell the class what the significant facts about the topic are.|[[O-Bin]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>}}
'''Response Time''' was an educational game played by students of [[The Learning]] at the [[Learning Circle]] on [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. In it, students would race to be the first to press a button and respond with the correct answer when the teacher displayed a topic on their personal display screens.
